body.message:
Good afternoon,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to kindly inform you that the property owner has requested a brief viewing of the apartment at the beginning of next week.

Would it be possible to accommodate the viewing either after 5:00 PM today or tomorrow, or before 10:00 AM? If so, kindly let us know your preferred date and time so we can coordinate with the owner accordingly.

The viewing will be brief, and we truly appreciate your kind cooperation and understanding.

Thank you in advance.
